question: The smallest and longest bones in the human body are ________ and _________, respectively.
solution:
The correct answer is __**stapes, femur.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The stapes **bone is the smallest bone in our body.

 
 
• The stapes bone is the innermost bone of our auditory ossicles in the **middle ear**.
 
 
 
• The **femur** is your thigh bone, it's the longest, **strongest bone** in your body.
 
 
• Femur work **Holding the weight** of your body when you stand and move.**​**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****

 
• The** fibula** is your calf bone, It's the smaller of the two bones in your lower leg.
 
• Fibula also supports lots of important muscles, tendons, nerves and ligaments.
 
• **206 to 213** bones in the human adult.
 
• **Mandible** bone is a movable bone in the skull of a man.
 
• Finger bones are also known as** Phalanges.**
